source_text: A guest must never see the admin link.
A guest must never be able to delete a user.
No page may ship a debug panel.
Every page must offer a skip-to-content link.
comment: The structured form of the English above. In Month 3 this file becomes the
expected output of the policy parser (M3-P1/M3-P2) rather than a hand-written
input — which is why the English is kept alongside it verbatim.
